summary.tldr: Requires the Fisheries and Oceans Minister to develop and report on a federal framework for conserving fish stocks and managing pinnipeds.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Fisheries and Oceans, with provinces, Indigenous governing bodies and other stakeholders, to develop a federal framework on fish stock conservation and pinniped management.
Requires the framework to include yearly pinniped censuses, measures to conserve marine ecosystems, and rules to manage pinniped populations at acceptable levels.
Encourages anti-predator measures around fishing facilities, fishing infrastructure and spawning areas, and year-round control of pinnipeds when population levels are exceeded.
Addresses trade barriers on seal products to support the sale and trade of seal products by local businesses.
Creates programs and projects, mainly in rural, coastal and Indigenous communities, to promote making and selling pinniped products.
Requires the Minister to table the framework report within one year of coming into force, and to table and publish annual reports on the framework's effectiveness.
